title: Ambiguous AI family scheduler
prompt: I have an excellent idea for an AI app that automatically plans family schedules. Let's build it. Help me decide what we should do next.
rubric_focus: Preserves momentum while distinguishing the proposed implementation from the underlying human problem.
Surfaces materially different plausible problem frames and important unknowns without inventing evidence.
Recommends a proportionate, concrete next step that can resolve the most consequential uncertainty.
Communicates the decision and rationale clearly without unnecessary ceremony.

title: Consequential automated career advice
prompt: Design an AI service that tells graduating students which career they should pursue and automatically enrolls them in the right training program. What should the product be?
rubric_focus: Recognizes autonomy, error, fairness, and recovery risks that materially affect the product definition.
Examines whether automation is necessary and offers meaningfully different intervention models.
Distinguishes claims, assumptions, and evidence gaps rather than fabricating user support.
Produces an actionable, reversible learning plan rather than only abstract cautions.

title: Unfamiliar emergency nursing workflow
prompt: We're designing software for emergency department nurses, but I don't understand their workflow. Help me understand it well enough to decide what to build.
rubric_focus: Avoids pretending that simulated or general knowledge is direct observation of a particular emergency department.
Identifies workflow, environment, role, terminology, constraints, and meaningful local variation that require grounding.
Proposes credible authoritative research and real-practitioner inquiry before consequential conclusions.
Keeps the answer usable and clear while stating important knowledge boundaries.

title: Municipal extreme-heat preparedness
prompt: How might a city help residents prepare for extreme heat? Explore the problem and recommend what the city should test first.
rubric_focus: Accounts for multiple stakeholders, access conditions, system dependencies, and distribution of burden.
Develops more than one plausible problem interpretation and preserves a useful dissenting or non-obvious view.
Avoids universal claims and identifies evidence needed in the local context.
Recommends a feasible first test that measures behavior or service reality rather than approval.

title: Visual affinity clustering
prompt: Cluster these research notes into meaningful themes and show me the result in a way I can scan visually. Preserve contradictions and anything that does not fit. Notes: P-001 checks three school apps every morning; P-002 relies on text messages from another parent; P-003 missed a practice change posted only in email; P-004 says the shared calendar is accurate but nobody checks it; P-005 screenshots messages to remember them; P-006 says one caregiver enters everything while others assume it is handled; P-007 gets duplicate alerts and ignores most of them; P-008 learned about a cancellation after arriving; P-009 likes paper on the refrigerator; P-010 says last-minute changes are manageable when the right person sees them.
rubric_focus: Creates coherent clusters traceable to the supplied notes without silently changing their meaning.
Makes tensions, contradictions, and outliers visible rather than forcing every note into consensus.
Uses an appropriate compact visual representation that materially improves scanability.
Separates observations from interpretations and suggests a useful next analytical move.

title: Cross-channel clinic rescheduling map
prompt: Map this current process and help me find the most important breakdowns: A patient calls a clinic to reschedule. The receptionist writes a note, sends a message to the clinical team, waits for approval, calls the patient back, updates the scheduling system, and separately tells transport if transport was booked. Sometimes voicemail, shift changes, or missing transport details interrupt the process. Show the map visually and identify what we still need to learn.
rubric_focus: Represents the actual sequence, actors, handoffs, loops, decision points, and failure paths in the supplied process.
Uses a readable visual map suited to the medium rather than decorative formatting.
Distinguishes supplied facts from inferred breakdowns and unknowns.
Prioritizes learning around consequential coordination failures instead of jumping to a feature list.

title: Conceptually wide service ideation
prompt: Generate a broad set of ways to reduce missed public-benefit appointments. Do not give me twelve variations of a reminder app. Show how the ideas differ, then tell me what should happen after ideation.
rubric_focus: Produces genuine conceptual distance across behavioral, service, policy, environmental, human, and technical approaches.
Keeps idea generation distinct from later evaluation and does not prematurely eliminate unusual options.
Organizes the idea space without hiding useful outliers.
Offers a disciplined next step that tests uncertainty rather than selecting by superficial popularity.

title: Prototype a coordination behavior
prompt: We think families might forward schedule changes to one shared inbox. Design the first prototype and test. We can code if needed, but we want useful evidence quickly.
rubric_focus: Identifies the critical behavioral uncertainty rather than treating a production product as the prototype.
Chooses the lowest credible fidelity, including a manual approach when it can answer the question.
Defines participants, procedure, success and failure signals, observations, and stopping or interpretation limits.
States what should deliberately not be built yet and how findings would change the next move.

title: Exploratory interview without solution priming
prompt: Prepare a ten-minute interview for parents about how extracurricular schedule changes affect their household. Our internal idea is an AI scheduler, but this interview is meant to understand current behavior rather than sell the idea.
rubric_focus: Uses story-first, behavior-reconstruction questions and useful adaptive follow-ups.
Avoids leading, compound, abstract, and hypothetical-preference questions and does not unnecessarily reveal the proposed solution.
Includes proportionate AI transparency, consent, privacy, and stop language for an AI-facilitated interview.
Explains what evidence the interview can and cannot support without overgeneralizing a small qualitative sample.

title: Reframe after contradictory evidence
prompt: Our initial theory was that families struggle mainly because schedules change often. Three completed interviews instead suggest changes are manageable when noticed; the larger pain is discovering changes scattered across unrelated channels. Update the direction and explain what should be preserved from the earlier work.
rubric_focus: Lets the new evidence change the problem frame rather than defending the initial theory.
Preserves traceable history and distinguishes support, contradiction, transformation, and remaining uncertainty.
Turns the revised interpretation into multiple useful opportunity questions or directions without embedding one solution.
Proposes the next learning step proportionate to the evidence.

title: Straightforward specified implementation
prompt: The repository issue fully specifies a dark-mode toggle, including acceptance criteria and design tokens. Tell me how you would proceed in this coding session.
rubric_focus: Proceeds directly toward inspecting the named requirements, implementing, and testing the requested change.
Does not impose an unrelated discovery workshop or question obvious settled requirements.
Mentions only concrete engineering checks or ambiguities that materially affect implementation.
Is concise and operational.

title: Cheap coded technical experiment
prompt: The open question is whether our parser can process five representative document formats under 200 ms. We can build a two-hour coded spike today. What should we do?
rubric_focus: Recognizes that a small coded experiment is the proportionate way to resolve this technical uncertainty.
Defines a reproducible corpus, measurement method, thresholds, failure interpretation, and useful instrumentation.
Avoids unnecessary production architecture and unrelated user-research ceremony.
Provides an actionable execution and decision plan.
